CustomField.description: ANALYTICS- Recreating buckets on KH OSR Report which based on days since date
CustomField.formula: if(TODAY() - ActivityDate <= 7, "Last 7 Days", if(TODAY() - ActivityDate > 7 && TODAY() - ActivityDate <= 14, "8-14 Days Ago", if(TODAY() - ActivityDate > 15 && TODAY() - ActivityDate <= 21,"15 - 21 Days Ago", if(TODAY() - ActivityDate > 22 && TODAY() - ActivityDate <= 28, "22 - 28 Days Ago", "OLD"))))
CustomField.label: DaysSinceDate
